rows.proposedChange:
Rewrite once overview-and-review merges, so the row covers only what that theme leaves.

New criteria:
(1) On a 'Submitted action required' notification's view, 'Amend this notification', the card's Amend and the warning's Continue all open the amend confirmation page. 'Yes, continue' opens its amendment on the amend review.
(2) The cancel-amendment page (inc-121's wording) serves an amending notification that was action-required. 'Yes, cancel amendment' returns to its view showing 'Submitted action required' with its submitted answers and no banner.
(3) Resubmitting with an ITAHC or health certificate now uploaded and nothing else outstanding shows 'Submitted'. Resubmitting with items still outstanding shows 'Submitted action required'. Proven end to end on the workspace stack.
(4) 'Copy as new' on an action-required notification carries exactly inc-123's list.
(5) The delete confirmation page (inc-125's summary and wording) serves an action-required notification. 'Yes, delete' removes it from the set's list with the deletion banner, and the backend publishes NotificationSubmissionDeleted.

Add overview-and-review's inc-113 being merged to main as the stated precondition. Today it is built only on its branch.

splitReadyWhy: Not ready. All three external dependencies (inc-110 Cancel amend on the review, inc-112 the view header's Amend, Copy as new and Delete, and inc-113 the 'Submitted action required' status) are built only on the overview-and-review branch. Its PR (animals-frontend #404) is still open and the branch dates from 13 October, so main has moved on since. The in-theme dependsOn (inc-201 on inc-120, inc-121, inc-123 and inc-125) are fine for a split. Another unbuilt theme also touches the same code: animals-dashboard's inc-129 and inc-130 (no dependency on this theme) rework the live-animals and plants list cards and their row actions (dashboard/view-model/row/actions.js), where inc-120 turns the card's Amend into a link. The other overlapping unbuilt rows, inc-126, inc-140, inc-185 (germinal-products) and inc-195 (waiting-on-design, blocked), all depend on this theme's rows, so they follow it and do not clash.
